versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους, μετῆρεν ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

controles.web: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judea beyond Jordan;
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus acabou estas palavras, partiu da Galileia, e veio para a região da Judeia, além do Jordão.

versos.grego: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ.

controles.web: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
controles.kjv: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
controles.livre: E muitas multidões o seguiram, e ele os curou ali.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ Φαρισαῖοι πειράζοντες αὐτὸν καὶ λέγοντες Εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀπολῦσαι τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἰτίαν;

controles.web: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
controles.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
controles.livre: Então uns fariseus se aproximaram dele e, provando-o, perguntaram: É lícito se divorciar da sua mulher por qualquer causa?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ὁ κτίσας ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς

controles.web: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
controles.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
controles.livre: Porém ele respondeu: Não tendes lido que aquele que os criou no princípio, macho e fêmea os fez,

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν Ἕνεκα τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ κολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν;

controles.web: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall join to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?’
controles.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
controles.livre: e disse: Portanto o homem deixará pai e mãe, e se unirá a sua mulher, e os dois serão uma única carne?

versos.grego: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία. ὃ οὖν ὁ Θεὸς συνέζευξεν, ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω.

controles.web: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
controles.livre: Assim eles já não são mais dois, mas sim uma única carne; portanto, o que Deus juntou, o ser humano não separe.

versos.grego: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο δοῦναι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι;

controles.web: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?”
controles.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
controles.livre: Eles lhe disseram: Por que, pois, Moisés mandou lhe dar carta de separação, e divorciar-se?

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὅτι Μωϋσῆς πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἐπέτρεψεν ὑμῖν ἀπολῦσαι τὰς γυναῖκας ὑμῶν· ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς δὲ οὐ γέγονεν οὕτως.

controles.web: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
controles.kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes disse: Por causa da dureza dos vossos corações Moisés vos permitiu divorciardes de vossas mulheres; mas no princípio não foi assim.

versos.grego: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐπὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην, μοιχᾶται.

controles.web: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
controles.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se divorciar de sua mulher, a não ser por causa de pecado sexual, e se casar com outra, adultera.

versos.grego: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί Εἰ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ αἰτία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός, οὐ συμφέρει γαμῆσαι.

controles.web: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
controles.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
controles.livre: Os discípulos lhe disseram: Se assim é a condição do homem com a mulher, não convém se casar.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ πάντες χωροῦσιν τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἀλλ’ οἷς δέδοται.

controles.web: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
controles.kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
controles.livre: Porém ele lhes disse: Nem todos recebem esta palavra, a não ser aqueles a quem é dado;

versos.grego: εἰσὶν γὰρ εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἐγεννήθησαν οὕτως, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν. ὁ δυνάμενος χωρεῖν χωρείτω.

controles.web: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
controles.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
controles.livre: Pois há castrados que nasceram assim do ventre da mãe; e há castrados que foram castrados pelos homens; e há castrados que castraram a si mesmos por causa do Reino dos céus. Quem pode receber isto ,receba.

versos.grego: Τότε προσηνέχθησαν αὐτῷ παιδία, ἵνα τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιθῇ αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεύξηται· οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
controles.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
controles.livre: Então lhe trouxeram crianças, para que pusesse as mãos sobre elas e orasse, mas os discípulos os repreendiam.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτὰ ἐλθεῖν πρός με· τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
controles.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus disse: Deixai as crianças, e não as impeçais de vir a mim, porque delas é o Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν.

controles.web: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
controles.kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
controles.livre: Ele pôs as mãos sobre elas, e depois partiu-se dali.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ εἶπεν Διδάσκαλε, τί ἀγαθὸν ποιήσω ἵνα σχῶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον;

controles.web: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
controles.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
controles.livre: E eis que alguém se aproximou-se dele, e perguntou: Bom Mestre, que bem farei para eu ter a vida eterna?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τί με ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ; εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός· εἰ δὲ θέλεις εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, τήρει τὰς ἐντολάς.

controles.web: He said to him, “Why do you call me good?No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: Por que me perguntas sobre o que é bom? Somente um é bom: Deus.  Porém se queres entrar na vida, guarda os mandamentos.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίας; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔφη Τὸ Οὐ φονεύσεις, Οὐ μοιχεύσεις, Οὐ κλέψεις, Οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις,

controles.web: He said to him, “Which ones?”   Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
controles.kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
controles.livre: Perguntou-lhe ele: Quais?E Jesus respondeu: Não cometerás homicídio, não adulterarás, não furtarás, não darás falso testemunho;

versos.grego: Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα, καὶ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

controles.web: ‘Honor your father and mother.’And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
controles.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
controles.livre: honra pai e mãe; e amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα· τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ;

controles.web: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
controles.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
controles.livre: O rapaz lhe disse: Tenho guardado tudo isso. Que me falta ainda?

versos.grego: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι, ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ δὸς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
controles.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se queres ser completo, vai, vende o que tens, e dá aos pobres. Assim terás um tesouro no céu. Então vem, segue-me.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν λόγον ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος· ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.

controles.web: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
controles.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
controles.livre: Mas quando o rapaz ouviu esta palavra, foi embora triste, porque tinha muitos bens.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πλούσιος δυσκόλως εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Jesus, então, disse aos seus discípulos: Em verdade vos digo que dificilmente o rico entrará no reino dos céus.

versos.grego: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρήματος ῥαφίδος εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Aliás, eu vos digo que é mais fácil um camelo entrar pela abertura de uma agulha do que o rico entrar no reino de Deus.

versos.grego: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες Τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι;

controles.web: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
controles.kjv: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
controles.livre: Quando os discípulos ouviram isso ,espantaram-se muito, e disseram: Quem, pois, pode se salvar?

versos.grego: ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν, παρὰ δὲ Θεῷ πάντα δυνατά.

controles.web: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
controles.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
controles.livre: Jesus olhou para eles ,e lhes respondeu: Para os seres humanos, isto é impossível; mas para Deus tudo é possível.

versos.grego: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι· τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν;

controles.web: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
controles.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
controles.livre: Então Pedro se pôs a falar, e lhe perguntou: Eis que deixamos tudo, e te seguimos; o que, pois, conseguiremos ter?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι, ἐν τῇ παλινγενεσίᾳ, ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ, καθήσεσθε καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo que vós que me seguistes, na regeneração, quando o Filho do homem se sentar no trono de sua glória, vós também vos sentareis sobre doze tronos, para julgar as doze tribos de Israel.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶς ὅστις ἀφῆκεν οἰκίας ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἐμοῦ ὀνόματός, πολλαπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει.

controles.web: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
controles.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que houver deixado casas, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou pai, ou mãe, ou filhos, ou terras por causa do meu nome, receberá muitas vezes mais, e herdará a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.

controles.web: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.
controles.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
controles.livre: Porém muitos primeiros serão últimos; e últimos, primeiros.
